LIFE-10.name: RESTART_MOVED
LIFE-10.description: Raised where a restart names an offer that is not the one a fresh look at the stack builds.

LIFE-11.name: MOUNT_LINKED
LIFE-11.description: Raised when a start finds a service's mount source reached through a link.

LIFE-12.name: OFFLINE_INSTALL_MOVED
LIFE-12.description: Raised where an `up` or a `switch` names an offer that is not the install a fresh look at the stack offers.

LIFE-13.name: OFFLINE_INSTALL_UNANSWERED
LIFE-13.description: Raised where a start would install a part this build carries and nobody said yes.

LIFE-14.name: OFFLINE_INSTALL_UNHELD
LIFE-14.description: Raised where an install a start was agreed to did not hold.

LIFE-3.name: ALREADY_WORKING
LIFE-3.description: Another run is already working on this stack.

LIFE-4.name: REGISTRY_REFUSED
LIFE-4.description: Fetching images is switched off, so there was nothing to fetch with.
